idea-plugin.name: Kubernetes Removed API Lint
idea-plugin.description:
15 checks for the apiVersions kubectl no longer serves, on the manifest open in your editor

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Kubernetes Removed API Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/k8s-removed-api-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/k8s-removed-api-lint

action.text: Kubernetes Removed API Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Kubernetes Removed API Lint on the file in the editor
